fca_results.src: ISO-NE key stats, Results of the Annual FCAs; FCA 18 filing ER24-1290 (2024-02-21)

auction_after_fca18.value: Annual Capacity Auction (prompt, sealed-bid), first May 2028 for CCP 2028/29
auction_after_fca18.seasonal_mri: CAR-SA: ISO aims to file by end-2026 for CCP 2028/29

ccp_calendar.rule: CCP runs 1 Jun to 31 May. No forward auction after FCA 18: the prompt ACA is held in early May before each CCP; a resource must demonstrate commercial operation by the deadline (illustrative 5 April) or it misses that CCP's auction and can only sell through monthly qualification (MRA / bilateral). CCP 2030/31 is the first ACA after the CONE / Net CONE recalculation. No seven-year price lock for new entrants.
ccp_calendar.note: The 5 April demonstration deadline is the filing's illustrative calendar.

price_path_default.rule: flat bands from cited clears (FCA 18; ARA/MRA prices about $5, peak $8 in 2025); user-set; never escalated

qc_solar_default.basis: fleet current-rule QC 561 of 1,409 MW MCap; replace with a site profile

qc_storage_default.basis: fleet current-rule QC 3,862 of 3,877 MW MCap (PSH + batteries); a 2-h and a 4-h battery of equal MW get the same QC

qc_rule_intermittent.value: 5-summer average of median net output in HE14–HE18 plus CSC hours; FCA qualified capacity = summer QC

qc_seasons.rule: Summer Intermittent Reliability Hours Jun–Sep (HE14–HE18); winter Oct–May (HE18–HE19). FCA / ACA qualified capacity of an intermittent resource = summer QC; non-intermittent = lesser of summer and winter QC

mric_season_months.rule: CAR-SA prices summer and winter separately; the season split of the seasonal auction is not in R2, so the current QC rule's Jun–Sep / Oct–May months are used

rmri_preliminary.note: Preliminary values; a CAR-SA price is per kW of MRIC, never per kW of QC.

balancing_ratio_cap.note: FERC acceptance of the cap not confirmed.

csc_interval_min.src: MR1 §III.13.7.2.1 (a CSC exists in any 5-minute interval in which the RCPF sets the reserve price)

stop_loss.monthly_rule: PfP subtracted from the Capacity Base Payment in an Obligation Month is limited to FCA Starting Price × CSO (excludes PfP for output above CSO)
stop_loss.src: MR1 §III.13.7.3.1-2; ER26-3047 fn 7; FCA 18 filing ER24-1290 (starting price)
stop_loss.note: FCA 18 starting price. FCA 15–17 starting prices and the ACA Offer Price Cap (which replaces it from CCP 2028/29) are not held (R2 open questions R3, R6).

pfp.formula: PfP = (1/Y) Σ_events Σ_intervals PPR × (A_t − CSO × min(BR_e, 1)) / 12, with monthly and annual stop-loss

events._note: All seven Capacity Scarcity Conditions since 2018-06-01 (system 30-min reserve shortfall). Public interval source: ISO-NE Capacity Scarcity Condition Report CSV. start/end are 5-minute interval-beginning labels, so the window ends 5 minutes after the last label.

rows.note: Labels 17:45–19:20 span 20 intervals; the ISO slide table gives 110 minutes (22 intervals). The replay weights the 20 labelled intervals to 22.

events.src: ISO-NE OP-4 / CSC reports (URLs in R2 §B3)

da_as.closeout_rule: close-out per MWh of DA obligation = max(0, hourly Real-Time Hub price − strike); strike = max(forecast hourly RT Hub + $10, 0) or the daily distillate-CT floor if higher
da_as.note: Hourly RT Hub, not 5-minute node prices. DA A/S design under IMM review (memo 2026-02-04).

regulation_base_case.rule: Regulation is a saturated market (468 MW of ATRR for about 93 MW of requirement): 0 in the base case; the sensitivity bound is the pro-rata share MW ÷ (ATRR + MW) of the 2025 pool

intervals.rule: RT settles on 5-minute intervals at the node; DA hourly; deviations from DA schedules settle at RT prices; generators are credited the FER Price on DA energy obligations

da_premium_2025.rule: Mass Hub simple averages; the DA price includes the FER Price, so the LMP-only premium is about $2

hub_hedge.rule: Financial PPA settled at Mass Hub: R_PPA = Σ q × (K − LMP_hub); basis Σ g × (LMP_node − LMP_hub) stays with the seller
hub_hedge.src: R2 §D2; MR1 §III.2.7-2.8 (hub = average of the hub node set)
